intro: Comfort food with better ingredients than its reputation: roasts, pies, puddings and a full breakfast, plus curry as a national dish.
flavours: Beef, potatoes, gravy, butter, malt vinegar, tea
hk: British pubs and Sunday roasts are an expat institution in Hong Kong, from Central to Sai Kung.

dishes.name: Fish and chips
dishes.what: Battered cod or haddock with thick-cut chips, salt and malt vinegar, often with mushy peas.

dishes.name: Full English breakfast
dishes.what: The big fry-up: eggs, bacon, sausage, beans, tomato, mushrooms, toast, often black pudding.

dishes.name: Sunday roast
dishes.what: Roast beef, lamb or chicken with roast potatoes, vegetables, Yorkshire pudding and gravy.

dishes.name: Shepherd's pie
dishes.what: Minced lamb in gravy under a crust of mashed potato (with beef it's cottage pie).

dishes.name: Beef Wellington
dishes.what: Fillet steak wrapped in mushroom duxelles and puff pastry, baked until golden.

dishes.name: Bangers and mash
dishes.what: Sausages on mashed potato with onion gravy.

dishes.name: Cornish pasty
dishes.what: Crimped pastry parcel of beef and vegetables from Cornwall, made to be eaten by hand.

dishes.name: Chicken tikka masala
dishes.what: Grilled chicken in a creamy spiced tomato sauce, invented in British curry houses.

dishes.name: Scones with cream tea
dishes.what: Scones with clotted cream and jam, with a pot of tea. Jam or cream first is a Devon-versus-Cornwall war.

dishes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
dishes.what: Soft date sponge soaked in hot toffee sauce, served with custard or ice cream.
